result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.symmetric_difference()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Compute the symmetric difference of this graph and another graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L12636-L12700){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.symmetric_difference(other) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Returns a new graph containing edges that are in exactly one of the two graphs. Equivalent to `(G1 - G2) ∪ (G2 - G1)`. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [other]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The graph to compare with. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A new graph containing edges in exactly one of the graphs. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If the graphs have different directedness. ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} - Both graphs must have the same directedness - Symmetric: `g1.symmetric_difference(g2) == g2.symmetric_difference(g1)` - Nodes without edges are excluded ## Examples {.doc-examples} Find edges unique to either graph: ::: {#b129734a .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec # Triangle g1 = ec.Graph(directed=False) for i in range(1, 4): g1.add_node() g1.add_edge(1, 2) g1.add_edge(2, 3) g1.add_edge(3, 1) # Path g2 = ec.Graph(directed=False) for i in range(1, 4): g2.add_node() g2.add_edge(1, 2) g2.add_edge(2, 3) # XOR: edges in one but not both sym_diff = g1.symmetric_difference(g2) # Returns 1 (3-1) sym_diff.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 1 ``` ::: ::: This is useful for comparing network versions to find all edges that changed (either added or removed) between snapshots.
